Name: ZelWorld - custom world music
Author: zelinknilez
Description:
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][b]You can customize the music that plays anywhere you want!
[/b][/size][/font]with simple JSON[/center]
[center][size=4]﻿If you have any questions, feel free to ask.[/size][/center]

1. Go to ZelWorld\assets(there will be sample files will be applied to FarmHouse(F for day, F2 for night) and Backwoods(same as FarmHouse but G and G2)).
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/sH3GRCg/asdfasdf.png[/img]

[/url]2. Add the wav files you want to hear:
[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/YWHNBgd/Kakao-Talk-20240331-211255384.png[/img]

[/url]3. Open the content.json file.

4. Modify the content.json file in the following format.
[code]{
﻿"Name": "Woods",
﻿"Day": [ "Woods", "Woods2" ],
﻿"Night": [ "Woods2" ],
﻿"IgnoredByRain": true
}
[/code]Copy & paste this code right after "IgnoredByRain": true[b] }, (you must add a comma after a pair of brackets)[/b] and edit:

[list]
[*][size=3]"Name":[b] "Woods"[/b] [/size]
[/list]-> your location name (you can find the name of the location [url=http://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Location_data#Location_names]here[/url])
[list]
[*][size=3]"Day": [ [b]﻿"Woods"[/b], [b]"Woods2"[/b] ][/size]
[/list]-> your wav file name(without .wav) [b]There can be one or multiple items.[/b] If there are multiple items, random music will be selected every day.
[list]
[*][size=3]"Night": [ [b]"Woods2"[/b] ] [/size]
[/list]-> your wav file name(without .wav) [b]There can be one or multiple items.[/b] If there are multiple items, random music will be selected every day.
[list]
[*][size=3]"IgnoredByRain": [/size][b][size=3]true[/size][/b]
[/list]-> [Optional, default false] whether the sound of rain will play instead of music when it rains. (true/false, doesn't need quotations)

As a result, you'll get the JSON file like this:
[code]﻿{
    "Places": [
      {
        "Name": "FarmHouse",
        "Day": [ "F" ],
        "Night": [ "F2" ]
      },
      {
        "Name": "Backwoods",
        "Day": [ "G" ],
        "Night": [ "G2" ],
        "IgnoredByRain": true
      },
      {
        "Name": "Woods",
        "Day": [ "Woods", "Woods2" ],
        "Night": [ "Woods2" ],
        "IgnoredByRain": true
      }
    ]
}
[/code][u][center][size=4]
That's all!
You can add as many locations as you want.[/size][/center][/u]
